``` {r c index}

data_for_cindex = cand_hx_list_episodes_grouping %>% 
  dplyr::select(WL_ID_CODE, INIT_AGE, TCR_DGN, start, end, death, EXCEPTION, STATUS) %>%
  group_by(WL_ID_CODE) %>% arrange(WL_ID_CODE, start) %>%
  mutate(
    status_without_exception = case_when(
      STATUS == "1B" & EXCEPTION == 1 ~ "2",
      STATUS == "1A" & EXCEPTION == 1 ~ "1B",
      TRUE ~ STATUS),
    new_status_normal = case_when(
      STATUS == "1A" ~ 1,
      STATUS == "1B" ~ 2,
      STATUS == "2" ~ 3),
    new_status_hypothetical = case_when(
      status_without_exception == "1A" ~ 1,
      status_without_exception == "1B" ~ 2,
      status_without_exception == "2" ~ 3),
    death_6weeks = ifelse(death == 1 & end <= 42, 1, 0),
    death_6weeks = ifelse(any(death_6weeks == 1), 1, 0)
    )

normalallocation <- coxph(Surv(start, end, death) ~ new_status_normal, data = data_for_cindex)
data_for_cindex$normal_predict <- predict(normalallocation, data_for_cindex, type = "lp")
get_normal_c <- function(data) {
  r <- risksetAUC(
    Stime = data$end,
    entry = data$start,
    status = data$death,
    marker = data$normal_predict,
    method = "Cox",
    tmax = 365,
    plot = F)
  return(r$Cindex)
}


timeseriesdata_short1 <- data_for_cindex[ ,c("WL_ID_CODE", "start", "end", "death", "normal_predict")]
timeseriesdata_nest1 <- timeseriesdata_short1 %>% nest(data = -WL_ID_CODE)

set.seed(200)
get_normal_c(data_for_cindex)

n_iterations <- 1000
bs <- rsample::bootstraps(timeseriesdata_nest1, times = n_iterations)
auc_normal <- vector(length = n_iterations)

for (i in 1:n_iterations) {
  normal_c <- as_tibble(bs$splits[[i]]) %>% unnest(cols = c("data")) %>% as.data.frame()
  auc_normal[i] <- get_normal_c(normal_c)
}


quantile(auc_normal, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))


hypotheticalallocation <- coxph(Surv(start, end, death) ~ new_status_hypothetical, data = data_for_cindex)
data_for_cindex$hypothetical_predict <- predict(hypotheticalallocation, data_for_cindex, type = "lp")
get_hypothetical_c <- function(data) {
  r <- risksetAUC(
    Stime = data$end,
    entry = data$start,
    status = data$death,
    marker = data$hypothetical_predict,
    method = "Cox",
    tmax = 365,
    plot = F)
  return(r$Cindex)
}

timeseriesdata_short2 <- data_for_cindex[ ,c("WL_ID_CODE", "start", "end", "death", "hypothetical_predict")]
timeseriesdata_nest2 <- timeseriesdata_short2 %>% nest(data = -WL_ID_CODE)

set.seed(200)
get_hypothetical_c(data_for_cindex)


n_iterations <- 1000
bs1 <- rsample::bootstraps(timeseriesdata_nest2, times = n_iterations)
auc_hypothetical <- vector(length = n_iterations)

for (i in 1:n_iterations) {
  hypothetical_c <- as_tibble(bs1$splits[[i]]) %>% unnest(cols = c("data")) %>% as.data.frame()
  auc_hypothetical[i] <- get_hypothetical_c(hypothetical_c)
}


quantile(auc_hypothetical, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

library(compareC)

compareC(data_for_cindex$end, data_for_cindex$death, data_for_cindex$new_status_normal, data_for_cindex$new_status_hypothetical)
```

``` {r time-dependent auc}

#THIS CREATES FIGURE 5

get_time_dependent_auc <- function(data, marker_col) {
  roc_result <- risksetAUC(
    Stime = data$end,
    entry = data$start,
    status = data$death,
    marker = data[[marker_col]],
    method = "Cox",
    tmax = 365,
    plot = FALSE
  )
  
  tibble(
    time = roc_result$utimes,
    auc = roc_result$AUC,
    c_index = roc_result$Cindex
  )
}

# ============================================================================
# SECTION 3: Calculate Point Estimates
# ============================================================================

set.seed(200)
auc_normal_point <- get_time_dependent_auc(data_for_cindex, "normal_predict")
auc_hypothetical_point <- get_time_dependent_auc(data_for_cindex, "hypothetical_predict")

cat("Normal allocation C-index:", round(auc_normal_point$c_index[1], 3), "\n")
cat("Hypothetical allocation C-index:", round(auc_hypothetical_point$c_index[1], 3), "\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# SECTION 4: Bootstrap
# ============================================================================

# Prepare nested data
timeseriesdata_nest <- data_for_cindex %>%
  select(WL_ID_CODE, start, end, death, normal_predict, hypothetical_predict) %>%
  nest(data = -WL_ID_CODE)

set.seed(200)
n_iterations <- 1000

cat("Running", n_iterations, "bootstrap iterations...\n\n")

# Create bootstrap samples
bs <- bootstraps(timeseriesdata_nest, times = n_iterations)

# Bootstrap for Normal allocation
cat("Bootstrap for Normal allocation...\n")
auc_normal_bootstrap <- map(1:n_iterations, function(i) {
  if (i %% 100 == 0) cat("  Iteration", i, "/", n_iterations, "\n")
  
  boot_data <- as_tibble(bs$splits[[i]]) %>% 
    unnest(cols = c(data))
  
  get_time_dependent_auc(boot_data, "normal_predict") %>%
    mutate(iteration = i)
})

auc_normal_bootstrap_df <- bind_rows(auc_normal_bootstrap)

# Bootstrap for Hypothetical allocation
cat("\nBootstrap for Hypothetical allocation...\n")
auc_hypothetical_bootstrap <- map(1:n_iterations, function(i) {
  if (i %% 100 == 0) cat("  Iteration", i, "/", n_iterations, "\n")
  
  boot_data <- as_tibble(bs$splits[[i]]) %>% 
    unnest(cols = c(data))
  
  get_time_dependent_auc(boot_data, "hypothetical_predict") %>%
    mutate(iteration = i)
})

auc_hypothetical_bootstrap_df <- bind_rows(auc_hypothetical_bootstrap)

cat("\nBootstrap complete!\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# SECTION 5: Interpolate to Fixed Time Grid (NEW SECTION - GOES HERE)
# ============================================================================

cat("Interpolating to fixed time grid...\n")

# Define fixed time grid
time_grid <- seq(0, 365, by = 5)  # Every 5 days

# Function to interpolate one bootstrap iteration
interpolate_one_bootstrap <- function(df) {
  # Handle edge cases
  if (nrow(df) < 2) {
    return(tibble(time = time_grid, auc = NA_real_))
  }
  
  tryCatch({
    interpolated_auc <- approx(
      x = df$time,
      y = df$auc,
      xout = time_grid,
      method = "linear",
      rule = 2
    )$y
    
    tibble(time = time_grid, auc = interpolated_auc)
  }, error = function(e) {
    # If interpolation fails, return NAs
    tibble(time = time_grid, auc = NA_real_)
  })
}

# Nest by iteration and interpolate
# Normal allocation
auc_normal_interpolated <- auc_normal_bootstrap_df %>%
  nest(data = c(time, auc, c_index)) %>%
  mutate(interpolated = map(data, interpolate_one_bootstrap)) %>%
  dplyr::select(iteration, interpolated) %>%
  unnest(interpolated)

# Check for any NAs
n_na_normal <- sum(is.na(auc_normal_interpolated$auc))
if (n_na_normal > 0) {
  cat("Warning:", n_na_normal, "NA values in normal allocation interpolation\n")
}

# Hypothetical allocation
auc_hypothetical_interpolated <- auc_hypothetical_bootstrap_df %>%
  nest(data = c(time, auc, c_index)) %>%
  mutate(interpolated = map(data, interpolate_one_bootstrap)) %>%
  dplyr::select(iteration, interpolated) %>%
  unnest(interpolated)

# Check for any NAs
n_na_hypo <- sum(is.na(auc_hypothetical_interpolated$auc))
if (n_na_hypo > 0) {
  cat("Warning:", n_na_hypo, "NA values in hypothetical allocation interpolation\n")
}

cat("Interpolation complete!\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# SECTION 6: Calculate Confidence Intervals at Fixed Time Points
# ============================================================================

# Normal allocation CIs
auc_normal_ci_fixed <- auc_normal_interpolated %>%
  group_by(time) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_auc = mean(auc, na.rm = TRUE),
    ci_lower = quantile(auc, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    ci_upper = quantile(auc, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_samples = sum(!is.na(auc)),  # Count non-NA samples
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Hypothetical allocation CIs
auc_hypothetical_ci_fixed <- auc_hypothetical_interpolated %>%
  group_by(time) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_auc = mean(auc, na.rm = TRUE),
    ci_lower = quantile(auc, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    ci_upper = quantile(auc, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_samples = sum(!is.na(auc)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Interpolate point estimates to same grid
auc_normal_point_interpolated <- tibble(
  time = time_grid,
  point_estimate = approx(
    auc_normal_point$time, 
    auc_normal_point$auc, 
    xout = time_grid, 
    rule = 2
  )$y
)

auc_hypothetical_point_interpolated <- tibble(
  time = time_grid,
  point_estimate = approx(
    auc_hypothetical_point$time, 
    auc_hypothetical_point$auc, 
    xout = time_grid, 
    rule = 2
  )$y
)

# Combine with CIs
auc_normal_ci_final <- auc_normal_ci_fixed %>%
  left_join(auc_normal_point_interpolated, by = "time") %>%
  mutate(system = "Normal Allocation")

auc_hypothetical_ci_final <- auc_hypothetical_ci_fixed %>%
  left_join(auc_hypothetical_point_interpolated, by = "time") %>%
  mutate(system = "Hypothetical Allocation")

# Combine both systems
auc_combined_ci <- bind_rows(auc_normal_ci_final, auc_hypothetical_ci_final)

# Verify
cat("=== Verification ===\n")
cat("Normal allocation samples per time point - min:", 
    min(auc_normal_ci_fixed$n_samples), 
    "max:", max(auc_normal_ci_fixed$n_samples), "\n")
cat("Hypothetical allocation samples per time point - min:", 
    min(auc_hypothetical_ci_fixed$n_samples), 
    "max:", max(auc_hypothetical_ci_fixed$n_samples), "\n")
cat("Number of time points:", length(time_grid), "\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# SECTION 7: Plot Time-Dependent AUC with Confidence Bands
# ============================================================================

auc_plot <- ggplot(auc_combined_ci, 
                   aes(x = time, y = point_estimate, 
                       color = system, fill = system)) +
  
  #geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", 
  #           color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.5) +
  
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), 
              alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Normal Allocation" = "#DF8F44",
      "Hypothetical Allocation" = "#374E55"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Normal Allocation" = "Current 3-Status System",
      "Hypothetical Allocation" = "Hypothetical Allocation\nwithout Exceptions"
    ),
    name = ""
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Normal Allocation" = "#DF8F44",
      "Hypothetical Allocation" = "#374E55"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Normal Allocation" = "Current 3-Status System",
      "Hypothetical Allocation" = "Hypothetical Allocation\nwithout Exceptions"
    ),
    name = ""
  ) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 365, 60),
    limits = c(0, 365)
  ) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0.6, 0.85),
    breaks = seq(0.6, 0.85, 0.05)
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Days after Initial Listing",
    y = "Time-Dependent AUC",
    #title = "Discrimination Performance Over Time",
    #subtitle = "Shaded bands represent 95% bootstrap confidence intervals",
    #caption = "Dashed line represents AUC = 0.5 (no discrimination)"
  ) +
  
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    legend.position.inside = c(0.8, 0.2),  # CHANGED: was legend.position
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    #legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, hjust = 0),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0, color = "gray40"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16),  # INCREASE X-AXIS NUMBERS
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),  # INCREASE Y-AXIS NUMBERS
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.3)
  )

print(auc_plot)

```
